answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to certify interaction graphs. In our protocol, multi-agent auditing enforces topological cut verifications across peer clusters. If fake nodes wander between communities, game-theoretic auditors detect bottlenecks as severe as fractures in a karst landscape, immediately slashing pledged jade reserves. Because certifying expanding cuts demands superlinear auditor collusion, attacker cost grows exponentially with network size.
